name: Dandruff & Hairfall Kit

description: Dandruff isn’t just about flakes - it’s one of the hidden causes of hair fall. What does it contain? 1. 1% Ketoconazole Shampoo: Fights dandruff at the source with 1% Ketoconazole for gentle exfoliation & scalp balance 2. usage: ✨ Consistency matters. Science that sets you free. Ketoconazole Shampoo Step 1: Wet your hair thoroughly with water. Step 2: Take a sufficient amount of Be Bodywise 1% Ketoconazole Shampoo in your palm and apply directly to the scalp. Step 3: Gently massage into your scalp. Leave for 1–2 minutes before rinsing well. Hair Health Gummies Take 1 gummy daily after a meal.

list.title: How to use (Ketoconazole Shampoo)
list.content:
Step 1
Take the shampoo in your palm and apply directly to your scalp and hair strands.
Step 2
Leave this anti-dandruff, paraben free shampoo for 1-2 minutes and rinse well. Follow up with Be Bodywise Deep Conditioner for Dry and Frizzy Hair.

list.title: How to use (Hair Health Gummies)
list.content:
Step 1
Eat 1 gummy daily after a meal.
Step 2
Simply chew - no water needed.

list.title: Important Information
list.content: If you are pregnant, we recommend consulting your healthcare professional before taking not just this supplement, but any supplement.  For nursing mothers, you can use these: <link of postpartum gummies> Made with biotin and other multivitamins, these supplements help strengthen your hair and ensure hair growth. However, it is not an immediate solution and results take up to 3 months to show. It is effective when consumed daily and is safe to continue well after the 3-4 month period if you wish to or can be replaced with a nutrient rich diet.
